subject: AWS Marketplace listing — audience messaging & product gallery assets
messages:
From: Linda Park <linda@cloudedge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2024 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace kickoff — quick ask on hero messaging and gallery

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for taking this on. We're preparing our AWS Marketplace listing for the CloudEdge/Redwood integration and want to make sure the product page hits the right audiences. Two quick asks to get rolling:

1) Do you have a short audience-focused hero paragraph (2–3 lines) that we can put at the top of the listing? We want something that speaks to platform teams evaluating inference economics and to developer buyers who care about latency/cost.

2) We're assembling a small gallery (3–4 images). Can the Redwood team review the asset list and suggest any additional screenshots or copy overlays you think will help conversion for co-sell?

I'm attaching our initial asset pack and a draft pricing matrix (pricing-matrix-cloudedge.xlsx). If it's easier, happy to do a 30-minute sync this week.

Thanks —
Linda Park
Head of Partnerships, CloudEdge Solutions
linda@cloudedge.com

Attachments: initial-assets.zip (contains hero mock, screenshot-1.png, screenshot-2.png)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Linda Park <linda@cloudedge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2024 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace kickoff — quick ask on hero messaging and gallery

Linda — great to hear from you and congrats on getting the page together.

Thanks for the attachments. I reviewed the screenshots and the pricing sheet. Attached is a short draft doc with: (a) two hero options (audience-first), (b) recommended 3-image gallery order and overlay text, and (c) suggested alt text for accessibility. See "REdwood_AWS_listing_draft.docx" attached. High level recommendations:

- Hero option A (developer-centric): "Ship LLM-powered features with predictable latency and pricing. Redwood Inference optimizes throughput and cost so your engineering team can focus on product."
- Hero option B (platform-centric): "A unified inference runtime for predictable performance across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments — operational controls for latency, cost, and compliance."

- Gallery: 1) Quickstart/SDK screenshot with caption "Start in minutes — REST & SDKs"; 2) Console observability dashboard with caption "Token-level cost & latency insights"; 3) Dedicated capacity config with caption "Predictable throughput for production".

Notes/questions:
- Pricing footnote: we should call out dedicated vs hosted pricing differences (CloudEdge can own the numbers, but we'll add the explanatory footnote on the page).
- Co-sell CTA: would you like a separate field for "Schedule co-sell intro" that maps to your partner intake form? If yes, share link and we can wire it into the listing CTA.

I can jump on a 30-min call this afternoon at 2pm PT if that works.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

Attachments: REdwood_AWS_listing_draft.docx, gallery_screens_v2.zip

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Linda Park <linda@cloudedge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2024 11:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace kickoff — quick ask on hero messaging and gallery

Jonas — thanks for the quick draft, looks solid. Couple of microcopy suggestions below (inline):

> Hero option A (developer-centric): "Ship LLM-powered features with predictable latency and pricing. Redwood Inference optimizes throughput and cost so your engineering team can focus on product."

Suggestion: tighten to: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost. Redwood optimizes throughput so engineering teams build faster."

> Hero option B (platform-centric): "A unified inference runtime for predictable performance across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments — operational controls for latency, cost, and compliance."

Suggestion: prefer the phrase "unified inference runtime" but remove the em-dash: "Unified inference runtime for predictable performance across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Operational controls for latency, cost, and compliance."

Gallery notes: agree with order. Add fourth image (light) showing "model variant routing" callout — that helps enterprise buyers understand graceful degradation and fallback.

Also: recommend we include a short testimonial quote (one line) from a developer at an early customer — Marissa, can you grab a 10–15 word quote and we can slot it under the hero?

I'll push a copy-cleaned doc in an hour.

Kimberly Park
Director, Marketplace Content & Partnerships
kimberly@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Linda Park <linda@cloudedge.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2024 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace kickoff — quick ask on hero messaging and gallery

Linda — thanks for looping us in. Quick next steps from the Redwood side: 

1) We'll finalize hero copy today using Kimberly's tightened language. Proposed hero to send to you: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost. Redwood optimizes throughput so engineering teams build faster."
2) I'll source a 10–15 word developer quote from an internal case (will send before EOD).
3) Jonas will add the co-sell CTA wiring — Linda, please send the partner intake URL if you want the CTA to open your form.
4) I'll upload the cleaned copy + alt text + final gallery images to the Drive folder and flag for AWS review. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cListingAssets

Linda — can you confirm the pricing numbers in pricing-matrix-cloudedge.xlsx are final for the listing and whether CloudEdge wants the "Dedicated" footnote described earlier? If not final, we'll use placeholder wording that points to your sales rep for billing questions.

If everyone is aligned we can submit to AWS for initial validation early next week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Product Marketing, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
